topic.title: Notification settings
topic.shortdesc: Choose what pushes to which device, what waits for a digest, and when to be left alone. Every change saves straight away.

image.alt: Notification settings: the categories table, quiet hours and devices.

body.p: One row per category (approvals, briefings, reminders, alerts, digests, social, orders and the rest). For each:

ul.li: Delivery: Push now, Next digest or In app only.
Sound and Priority. Urgent always pushes, even in quiet hours.

body.p: When one category pushes many times in a few minutes, the rest collapse into one and N more. The number field sets how many before that happens; 0 means no limit.
Override a category for one business, for example turn off 3dpandme social: pick the business, the category and the behaviour, and choose Add override.

topic.title: Quiet hours and the quick briefing

body.p: Between From and To, everything except urgent notifications (and approvals, if you tick Let approvals through) is held and arrives as one summary when quiet hours end.
The Quick briefing is one push at the time you set with today's counts: approvals waiting, tasks and spend. It doesn't run an agent.

ol.li: On the phone or PC, choose Enable on this device and allow notifications.
Set what it Gets: Urgent only, High and urgent, Normal and up or Everything.

body.p: Send test checks it; Remove stops pushes to it. On an iPhone, push only works from the app added to the home screen. If the page says push is not configured, the server is missing its VAPID keys; notifications still appear in the app.
